title: A fix check may take the record's own top-round head as its fix base
why: Lane record-rounds-name-own-head (session_013NEJL2WYHwGu4KngBLPUaF), coordinator pick b, 17:18 CST Nov 8; Merge after: #2277. On q_max #1149 and on #2323, fix checks passed after round 3, but the tool could not record them: no record on the PR had the round-3 head as its Head, because the PR opened later or a fix check was already on the record. Both PRs paid for a fresh rounds 1-3 chain. Rule: when the new record names per-round heads (#2277), `--fix-check` may take the record's own top-round sha as its fix base. The write step already proves that sha is one of the PR's commits. Related: step fix-check-chain (a second fix check starts from the previous fix check's head).
note: The lane builds it after #2277 passes round 3. Sighting (coordinator 17:56 CST Nov 8, #2322): after a record that names the live head with no Fix check line, the tool cannot record a fix check over base..head, because --fix-check's base must be the newest record's Head. The lane ran a fresh round 3 instead. Folded in, 21:27 CST Nov 9: proposed step record-names-round-head (coordinator 21:23 CST; lane past-ruling-reads-newer-ruling, 21:22 CST). Incident: on #2487 the posted record issuecomment-6758001838 named a Head other than the head round 2 read, and the merge tool refused a fix check from either head. Gap: `merge --review-record` takes one --head, no head per round. Fix idea: each --round carries the head it read, and --fix-check starts from the last round's head. Red case first: round 2 read at head A with --head B refuses or names the mismatch. Folded in, 01:34 CST Nov 10 (coordinator; debt review-record-fix-base-unposted, decision pr-review-record): `merge --review-record` cannot write a fix check whose base is a head with no earlier posted record, and refuses a record at a non-live head. Hit by 5 lanes on Nov 9-10 (#2479, #2482, #2490, #2486, #2492); a lane that fixes after a round it never posted lists the fix check in free text, or bends the round lines (#2492 entered its fix check as round 2). Case for debt review-record-fix-base-unposted (coordinator 02:19 CST Nov 10): a retyped record with a Fix check line blocks a second fix check from chaining (#2378, comment 6762059295).
